findings.title: Cache is not re-checked after taking the write lock, so concurrent misses each reload the assets.
findings.body: When the cache is empty (for example at startup), several requests can all see `ret == nil` under the read lock. Each one then waits for the write lock in turn and reads and parses the manifest again, even after the first one has filled the cache. Fix: after `Lock()`, check again with `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }` before loading.
